programme.title: Kissa Ka Bhai Kissi Ki Jaan
programme.desc: Bhaijaan, the eldest brother of three siblings, refuses to get married to maintain harmony in his family. However, complications arise after his brothers conspire for him to fall in love.

programme.title: Good Boy Bad Boy
programme.desc: Directed by Ashwini Chaudhary, this coming-of-age drama features Emraan Hashmi and Tusshar Kapoor as students with contrasting personalities. When they switch places, chaos ensues, affecting their academic and personal lives. The film is a remake of the 1992 movie Class Act.

programme.title: Singh Saab The Great
programme.desc: Singh Saab is a responsible tax collector who believes in honesty, but Bhoodev, a conniving man, plots against him. Singh adopts a unique way to teach Bhoodev a lesson.

programme.title: Raksha Bandhan
programme.desc: The eldest brother to four sisters, a chaat shop seller relentlessly strives to keep his promise to his ailing mother while also upholding their family values.

programme.title: Simmba
programme.desc: Simmba follows the story of Sangram "Simmba" Bhalerao, a corrupt and flamboyant police officer who enjoys the perks of his position until a personal tragedy forces him to rethink his choices. Transforming into a man of justice, Simmba takes on a powerful criminal nexus. With high-octane action, emotional drama, and punchy dialogues, this Rohit Shetty directorial stars Ranveer Singh and Sara Ali Khan in a thrilling narrative of redemption.
